findings.pdf_says: Table 18, row HIGH-VALUE, HIGH-VALUES; LOW-VALUE, LOW-VALUES; and QUOTE, QUOTES: receiving-operand column lists nine lines 'Alphabetic / Alphanumeric / Alphanumeric-edited / National / National-edited / Numeric / Numeric-edited / — if usage is display / — if usage is national' against category column 'Alphanumeric / Alphanumeric / Alphanumeric / National / National / Alphanumeric / (blank) / Alphanumeric / National' - Numeric-edited has no category of its own; '— if usage is display' maps to Alphanumeric and '— if usage is national' maps to National.

findings.why_it_matters: The two numeric-edited sub-lines are merged onto one line and the blank category cell is dropped, so the line-by-line pairing now reads Numeric-edited -> Alphanumeric and 'if usage is display / if usage is national' -> National, losing that a numeric-edited receiver of usage display gets an alphanumeric figurative constant and one of usage national gets a national one.
